title: When Pruning Meets Interpretability: Preserving Sparse Autoencoder Robustness in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.25941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to interpret the internal representations of large language models (LLMs), yet their reliability under post-hoc model compression remains poorly understood. We present a systematic study of how pruning affects SAE behavior and theoretically show that, for a fixed SAE, its impact is governed by perturbation energy, a covariance-weighted norm. This perspective exposes a key limitation of magnitude pruning: by ignoring activation geometry, it distorts the learned representation space and degrades SAE functionality. Activation-aware methods such as Wanda and SparseGPT, in contrast, implicitly control perturbation energy and are therefore substantially more robust at preserving SAE behavior. We further reveal a consistent structural vulnerability across all pruning methods: middle layers are significantly more sensitive to pruning than early or late layers. translated_title: 当剪枝遇上可解释性：在大语言模型中保持稀疏自编码器的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）被广泛用于解释大型语言模型（LLMs）的内部表示，但它们在事后模型压缩下的可靠性仍然知之甚少。我们系统性地研究了剪枝如何影响SAE行为，并从理论上证明，对于固定的SAE，其影响由扰动能量（一种协方差加权范数）决定。这一视角揭示了幅度剪枝的关键局限性：通过忽略激活几何结构，它扭曲了学习到的表示空间并降低了SAE功能。相比之下，激活感知方法（如Wanda和SparseGPT）隐式地控制了扰动能量，因此在保持SAE行为方面更为鲁棒。我们进一步揭示了所有剪枝方法中一致的结构性弱点：中间层对剪枝的敏感性显著高于早期或晚期层。基于这一见解，我们提出了一种分层...
tldr: 本文系统研究了剪枝对LLM中稀疏自编码器行为的影响，发现幅度剪枝因忽略激活几何而损害可解释性，而激活感知方法更鲁棒，并指出中间层对剪枝最敏感。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies how pruning affects sparse autoencoder behavior in LLMs, revealing that magnitude pruning harms interpretability by ignoring activation geometry, while activation-aware methods are more robust, and middle layers are most sensitive to pruning.
